messages:
ryan_oncall: 🚨 seeing a steady 5xx spike from api-gateway. Root cause looks like requests matching header X-Route-Version == 'v2-experimental' are being routed to the experimental backend which is dropping tokens. Need to rescind the binding for prod us-west-2 now, please.
sasha: Which match type? header or prefix? quick confirm so we don't flip the wrong rule.
rachel: header-based. The canary header got into some upstream proxies and bypassed the normal quota checks. Telemetry: token-per-request surged on /telemetry/token_usage around 12:04UTC.
alex: I'm in the console UI. There's an action called "rescind circuit" on the route detail page but also an admin API. Which do you want us to use? env=prod us-west-2?
ryan_oncall: Yes prod us-west-2. Use admin API so it's auditable. Command (run with ADMIN_TOKEN):

```
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/routes/rescind" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"route_id":"api-main","match":{"type":"header","name":"X-Route-Version","value":"v2-experimental"},"dry_run":false,"ttl_seconds":3600}'
```

Set ttl_seconds to 3600 so it auto-rolls back if nobody acknowledges in an hour. Add a short incident log entry when you run it.
marta: I'll execute with ryan. running now.
deploy-bot: deploy-job #4321 started by marta — rescind-route api-main (match header X-Route-Version=v2-experimental)
marta: Done. API returned 200 OK. action_id=rs-202403-549
alex: Seeing metrics now: 5xx rate dropped from ~4.2% to ~0.3% over the last 2m. Token-per-request back to baseline. Telemetry link: https://telemetry.internal/dashboards/route_token_usage?range=5m&panel=api-main :thumbsup:
jamie: We should add a temporary reject rule for unknown X-Route-Version values at the gateway (403) and follow up with a config PR to whitelist allowed header values. I'll own the PR.
ryan_oncall: Good. Add an incident note: action_id=rs-202403-549, owner=@jamie for follow-up. Keep the rescind TTL 1h for now; if root cause is mitigated we'll revert earlier. Closing this thread unless someone sees residual errors. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
